scoring.requirementsCoverage: requirements present in canonical evidence manifest / canonical requirement count
scoring.traceability: requirements with at least one implementation evidence path / canonical requirement count
scoring.tests: automated quality gate plus required manual/external validation status; cannot be 100 while manual/external requirements remain
scoring.evidence: applicable controls with completed validation mode; technical evidence counts complete only when CI is green; external/manual/operational modes count complete only with approved evidence records
scoring.documentation: current canonical sections and tables reconciled against the checkpoint SHA
scoring.architecture: as-built components/APIs/ADRs/sequence/data boundaries reconciled against the checkpoint SHA
scoring.risks: open material risks with owner, treatment, evidence and acceptance criteria resolved or formally accepted

rules: No metric reaches 100 from CI alone when its definition requires human, operational or production evidence.
Not-applicable controls are excluded from the evidence denominator only when applicability is explicitly documented.
No task/risk is treated as closed without evidence.
Overall score is the weighted arithmetic mean of the nine metrics.
Delivery recommendation is Ready for Main only when no blocking inconsistency exists; Ready for Production additionally requires all 15 production-readiness checks.
